title: Olivia Shepard — priority log & quick handoffs
content:
Day log (snapshot) - quick brain dump

WEEKLY THEME: Reduce inference cost variance; harden Dedicated SLAs. Keep public comms calm while we run the quota experiments.

TOP 3 for this week
- Approve Dedicated capacity pricing tweak (need math from Finance) — action: Marco to run sensitivity by Fri.
- Hit v2 rollout checklist for model-routing failover (canary -> 50% -> 100%) — prep: checklist below.
- Get SRE signoff on autoscale cold-start mitigation plan (short doc review) — ping Ravi.

TODAY (quick schedule + prep notes)
08:30 — 1:1 Tess (30m) 
  - Agenda: hiring update, onboarding budget for new infra SWE, unblock for console UX review.
  - Ask: can we push hire to April 15 or keep March? Tess estimate on ramp time.
10:00 — Ops sync (15m)
  - Quick status: Dedicated cluster instability window yesterday (eu-west-1) — root cause suspect: nightly maintenance + kernel upgrade. Checklist: node-image, driver versions, preflight.
11:00 — Canary rollout readout (30m)
  - Bring: rollout dashboard, p95/p99 latency delta, token-cost delta, errors by route.
  - Qs to ask engineering: expected QPS headroom for 2x burst and fallback plan.
13:00 — Lunch: prep notes for Board touchpoint (Thu)
16:00 — Finance deep-dive (45m)
  - Need clear unit economics: host vs dedicated, amortized GPU hours, caching impact. Request: finance to show month-over-month cost per 1M tokens by bucket.

ROLLOUT CHECKLIST (canary -> scale) — notes to self
- confirm telemetry tags included (model_variant, route, customer_tier)
- validate automatic fallback policy exists and tested (unit test link in review)
- smoke test script: 50 requests seq len 512, sampling rates
- rollback plan: immediate route to baseline model, notify support with canned message
- stakeholder notify list: product, solutions-eng, SRE, sales-EMs

OPEN FOLLOW-UPS (short)
- Finance: run sensitivity on Dedicated price tiers (Marco) — due Fri
- SRE: verify autoscale cold-start mitigation (Ravi) — pending doc review link in PR list
- Solutions-eng: customer X follow-up on SLA exceptions (Tess) — customer B wants stricter guarantees; need proposal for private deployment timeline

NOTES TO SELF (scratch)
- Draft Board bullets: 1) cost optimization progress, 2) Dedicated revenue pipeline, 3) Private deployment pilot status. Keep messaging conservative re: timing.
- Quick Slack DM to @infra-team about kernel rollouts schedule.
- Draft short FAQ for customers about transient token price experiments (avoid internal jargon).

MISC TRIVIA / IDEAS (capture)
- Could we add a short "cost mode" flag to API to prioritize p95 vs unit cost for heavy batch workloads? Prototype thought — ask runtime team for feasibility.
- Consider a weekly cadence of 15-min SRE checkpoints during stressful rollouts.

QUICK CHECKBOX (today)
[ ] Send canary roll-out brief to Sales EMs
[ ] Approve PR for telemetry tagging (PR#451)
[ ] Reply to Board secretary w/ 2 slots for Thursday prep

END OF SNAPSHOT — update when calls finish.

Notes: still messy, intentionally terse. Use as my single-source scratchpad for the day; copy items into Action items after meetings.
